title: Spike: a one-playback link survives a long pause on Media3.
description: Serves Goal 1: "Playback never surprises a viewer."; "Seeking and resuming just work.". No dependencies. Takes JS-182's first criterion. The result goes to the product owner before JS-217's Spec.
acceptanceCriteria: On Media3 on an emulator, a link with its secret in the path and relative URLs inside its playlists, carrying no header or query credential, plays, survives a 30-minute pause and then a seek; recorded in docs/ with the player, version and command; the result goes to the product owner before JS-217's Spec.
What Media3 reports to the app when a link is refused because its playback ended, so that an app can start again with nothing shown to the viewer.
notes: Phase S4 chosen (spike sibling JS-182, S4); ux flag left unset. Backlog BL-317 promoted when Octave's iOS build starts covers AVPlayer. Observed 2026-11-27 (docs/pathsecret-link.md): the link survived a 30m05s pause and a seek on Media3 1.11.1, one emulator; a refused ended link raised onLoadError and no onPlayerError within 90 s. To the product owner before JS-217's Spec.
